rows.name: Office for Nuclear Regulation Corporate Plan 2026 to 2027
rows.semantic_limit: Planned regulatory priorities and intended work are governance context, not observed safety performance or evidence of hazard at a nuclear site, address or parcel.

rows.name: Nuclear Decommissioning Authority annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Group-level decommissioning, incident and environmental performance cannot be used as a direct measurement of safety, contamination or risk at a named site or exact parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official NDA report covers hazard reduction, decommissioning, radioactive-waste management, safety, security and environmental performance for 2025 to 2026.

rows.name: National Highways annual report and accounts 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Strategic-road-network performance and maintenance reporting cannot establish collision likelihood, response conditions or safety at a particular road segment, property or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official annual report covers operation, maintenance and improvement performance for England's strategic road network in 2025 to 2026.

rows.name: Patient Safety Commissioner annual report 2025 to 2026
rows.publisher: Patient Safety Commissioner and Department of Health and Social Care
rows.semantic_limit: National patient-safety advocacy, governance and programme reporting does not measure treatment quality or harm probability at a provider, household or exact parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official report summarises the Patient Safety Commissioner's work during the 2025 to 2026 financial year.

rows.name: NHS Resolution annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Claims, indemnity, dispute-resolution and organisational performance are institutional context and must not be interpreted as incident rates or safety at a named provider, patient or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official annual report includes NHS Resolution's performance, accountability and financial statements for 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.

rows.name: Police workforce open data tables, 31 March 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Force-level staffing, joiner, leaver, function and demographic tables do not establish patrol availability, response time, crime risk or safety at an address or exact parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official Home Office page provides open data tables for the police workforce, including workforce, functions, joiners, leavers, absence and other dimensions as at 31 March 2026.

rows.name: Environment Agency annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Agency-wide performance measures and financial reporting do not establish flood, pollution, water-quality or environmental risk at a specific location or parcel.
